slides.title: What is Lifeforce?
slides.subtitle: Insights from Dr. Bruce H. Lipton
points: Your body is a complex biological machine composed of approximately 50 Trillion cells.
Every single cell operates electrically. The average membrane potential for a healthy human cell is 70 mV (0.07 volts).
This internal electrical charge is what defines the capacity of the cell to absorb nutrients, expel waste, and perform vital functions.
When cellular voltage drops, cellular performance drops, leading to lethargy, chronic conditions, and systemic failure.

slides.title: The Mathematics of Vitality
slides.subtitle: You Are Power Iterated
slides.content: When you multiply the vast number of cells in the human body by the electrical potential of each individual cell, the result is staggering.
slides.formula: 50 x 10^12 Cells x 0.07 Volts = 3.5 x 10^12 Volts
slides.conclusion: This immense electrical capacity is your true Lifeforce, traditionally known in ancient sciences as Pranik Shakti.

slides.title: You Are Electric!
slides.subtitle: Cellular Voltage is the Key
content: Human beings are fundamentally electrical organisms. Our nervous system, our heartbeats, and our cognitive functions are all driven by electrical currents.
Maintaining optimal cellular voltage ensures that the body's internal communication networks remain fast, clear, and efficient.
A drop in this electrical potential is the physiological precursor to what we interpret as fatigue, aging, and disease.

slides.title: The Three States of Pranik Shakti

states.name: Presence (Life)
states.description: When Lifeforce flows unhindered, cells maintain high voltage. This state is characterized by high energy, robust immunity, rapid cellular regeneration, and systemic homeostasis.

states.name: Blockage (Disease)
states.description: When the electrical flow is impeded by physical toxins, emotional stress, or nutritional deficits, voltage drops. This restriction of Lifeforce manifests as physiological disease.

states.name: Absence (Death)
states.description: When the cellular battery drains completely and membrane potential collapses, the biological machine ceases to function. The complete absence of electrical Lifeforce is clinical death.

states.name: Flowing
states.description: Unobstructed electrical pathways leading to vibrant health.

states.name: Blocked
states.description: Tension and resistance reducing voltage, causing stagnation.

slides.title: Unblocking Your Lifeforce
slides.subtitle: Practical strategies to restore cellular voltage and optimize your 3.5 Trillion Volts.

strategies.name: Alkaline Nutrition
strategies.description: Consume electron-rich foods (raw vegetables, clean water) that donate voltage rather than steal it, maintaining healthy membrane potential.

strategies.name: Deep Oxygenation
strategies.description: Breathwork practices increase cellular oxygen uptake, which is mandatory for mitochondrial ATP production and maintaining high voltage.

strategies.name: Epigenetic Mindset
strategies.description: Following Dr. Lipton's work, positive beliefs and reduced stress lower cortisol, preventing the "fight or flight" drain on your bio-battery.

strategies.name: Earthing (Grounding)
strategies.description: Physical contact with the earth allows direct transfer of free electrons from the ground into the body, instantly neutralizing free radicals.

slides.title: Reclaim Your 3.5 Trillion Volts
slides.content: Disease is not a permanent state; it is a signal of blocked energy. By changing your cellular environment, you can unblock your Lifeforce and restore vibrant health.
